sources.title: Qwen/Qwen2-Math-7B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: For requirements on GPU memory and the respective throughput, see similar results of Qwen2 here. Qwen2-Math-7B-Instruct is an instruction model for chatting; Qwen2-Math-7B is a base model typically used for completion and few-shot inference, serving as a better starting point for fine-tuning.
